answer: The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The ivory holds work receipts rather than names, so the terrace of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
